# Events

<div class="gen-note">Generated from the APS 3.0 source code: every name, pin, default and description below is read from the plugin itself, so it matches what you see in the editor.</div>

Two kinds of events. **Bind** the first kind: select the component, and at the bottom of its Details click **+** next to the event. **Override** the second kind in a Blueprint made from the class (a Listener, a policy, a sense), from the **Functions** list's **Override** menu.

### APS Perception Listener

### APS Fusion Policy
Make a Blueprint child of this class and set it on the profile's Fusion Policy to decide how senses combine.

<div class="bpn-list"><div class="bpn event" id="o-aps-fusion-policy-fuseconfidence" data-search="Fuse Confidence" data-text="Combine this tick&#x27;s sense contributions into a single confidence [0..1]. @param Samples One entry per sense slot, in profile order. @param CorroborationBonus The profile&#x27;s per-extra-sense bonus, for reference."><div class="bpn-head"><span class="bpn-icon"></span><b>Fuse Confidence</b><span class="badge">override in Blueprint</span></div><div class="bpn-meta"><span>Event to override</span> <span>Target is <b>APS Fusion Policy</b></span> <span class="cat">APS › Policy</span></div><div class="bpn-pins"><div class="bpn-in"><span class="pin struct container" title="Array of APSSense Sample"><i></i><b>Samples</b><small>Array of APSSense Sample</small></span><span class="pin float" title="Float"><i></i><b>Corroboration Bonus</b><small>Float</small></span></div><div class="bpn-out"><span class="pin float" title="Float"><i></i><b>Return Value</b><small>Float</small></span></div></div><div class="bpn-doc"><p>Combine this tick&#x27;s sense contributions into a single confidence [0..1].</p><p>@param Samples            One entry per sense slot, in profile order. @param CorroborationBonus The profile&#x27;s per-extra-sense bonus, for reference.</p></div></div></div>

### APS Threat Policy
Make a Blueprint child and set it on the profile's Threat Policy to score threats your way.

<div class="bpn-list"><div class="bpn event" id="o-aps-threat-policy-scorethreat" data-search="Score Threat" data-text="Score how dangerous this target is, [0..1]. @param Record The belief, including confidence, damage history and lifecycle. @param Relationship Resolved from the Relationship component, if present."><div class="bpn-head"><span class="bpn-icon"></span><b>Score Threat</b><span class="badge">override in Blueprint</span></div><div class="bpn-meta"><span>Event to override</span> <span>Target is <b>APS Threat Policy</b></span> <span class="cat">APS › Policy</span></div><div class="bpn-pins"><div class="bpn-in"><span class="pin struct" title="Belief Record"><i></i><b>Record</b><small>Belief Record</small></span><span class="pin enum" title="Target Relationship"><i></i><b>Relationship</b><small>Target Relationship</small></span></div><div class="bpn-out"><span class="pin float" title="Float"><i></i><b>Return Value</b><small>Float</small></span></div></div><div class="bpn-doc"><p>Score how dangerous this target is, [0..1].</p><p>@param Record       The belief, including confidence, damage history and lifecycle. @param Relationship Resolved from the Relationship component, if present.</p></div></div></div>

### APS Attention Policy

<div class="bpn-list"><div class="bpn event" id="o-aps-attention-policy-selectattentiontarget" data-search="Select Attention Target" data-text="Choose the attention target. Return null for &quot;nothing worth attending to&quot;, or Current to hold what the AI already has. @param Candidates Active actor beliefs, highest sort score first. @param Current What the AI is attending to now. May be null. @param TimeOnCurrent Seconds it has been committed to "><div class="bpn-head"><span class="bpn-icon"></span><b>Select Attention Target</b><span class="badge">override in Blueprint</span></div><div class="bpn-meta"><span>Event to override</span> <span>Target is <b>APS Attention Policy</b></span> <span class="cat">APS › Policy</span></div><div class="bpn-pins"><div class="bpn-in"><span class="pin struct container" title="Array of Belief Record"><i></i><b>Candidates</b><small>Array of Belief Record</small></span><span class="pin object" title="Actor"><i></i><b>Current</b><small>Actor</small></span><span class="pin float" title="Float"><i></i><b>Time on Current</b><small>Float</small></span><span class="pin float" title="Float"><i></i><b>Stickiness Time</b><small>Float</small></span><span class="pin float" title="Float"><i></i><b>Switch Threshold</b><small>Float</small></span></div><div class="bpn-out"><span class="pin object" title="Actor"><i></i><b>Return Value</b><small>Actor</small></span></div></div><div class="bpn-doc"><p>Choose the attention target. Return null for &quot;nothing worth attending to&quot;, or Current to hold what the AI already has.</p><p>@param Candidates      Active actor beliefs, highest sort score first. @param Current         What the AI is attending to now. ### APS Significance Policy
Make a Blueprint child and set it on the APS subsystem to rank which AI get full-quality updates.

<div class="bpn-list"><div class="bpn event" id="o-aps-significance-policy-scoresignificance" data-search="Score Significance" data-text="Score an agent&#x27;s importance, [0..1]. Higher is more important: it ticks more often and wins perception budget when the frame is contended. @param Agent The agent being scored. @param NearestViewerDist Distance to the closest local viewer, in cm. A very large value when nobody is watching. @param bIs"><div class="bpn-head"><span class="bpn-icon"></span><b>Score Significance</b><span class="badge">override in Blueprint</span></div><div class="bpn-meta"><span>Event to override</span> <span>Target is <b>APS Significance Policy</b></span> <span class="cat">APS › Significance</span></div><div class="bpn-pins"><div class="bpn-in"><span class="pin object" title="APS Core"><i></i><b>Agent</b><small>APS Core</small></span><span class="pin float" title="Float"><i></i><b>Nearest Viewer Dist</b><small>Float</small></span><span class="pin bool" title="Boolean"><i></i><b>Is Engaged</b><small>Boolean</small></span><span class="pin int" title="Integer"><i></i><b>Awareness</b><small>Integer</small></span></div><div class="bpn-out"><span class="pin float" title="Float"><i></i><b>Return Value</b><small>Float</small></span></div></div><div class="bpn-doc"><p>Score an agent&#x27;s importance, [0..1]. Higher is more important: it ticks more often and wins perception budget when the frame is contended.</p><p>@param Agent            The agent being scored. @param NearestViewerDist Distance to the closest local viewer, in cm. A very large value when nobody is watching. @param bIsEngaged       True when this agent currently has a Detected or Tracked target — it is doing something a player is likely to be in the middle of. @param Awareness        Highest awareness level, 0 (Unaware) to 4.</p></div></div></div>

### APSHealth Provider

<div class="bpn-list"><div class="bpn event" id="o-apshealth-provider-getapshealthfraction" data-search="Get APSHealth Fraction" data-text="Remaining health as a fraction, 1 for untouched and 0 for dead. ### APSStance Provider
An interface: implement it on your character so APS can read its stance (standing, crouching, prone) from your own movement code.

<div class="bpn-list"><div class="bpn event" id="o-apsstance-provider-getapsstance" data-search="Get APSStance" data-text="Current posture."><div class="bpn-head"><span class="bpn-icon"></span><b>Get APSStance</b><span class="badge">override in Blueprint</span></div><div class="bpn-meta"><span>Event to override</span> <span>Target is <b>APSStance Provider</b></span> <span class="cat">APS › Adapters</span></div><div class="bpn-pins"><div class="bpn-in"></div><div class="bpn-out"><span class="pin enum" title="APSStance"><i></i><b>Return Value</b><small>APSStance</small></span></div></div><div class="bpn-doc"><p>Current posture.</p></div></div></div>
